notes: FGA_LT_06 is stored in per-game units; total defended rim attempts are FGA_LT_06 * GP.

The 80-attempt persistence threshold was reconstructed because it exactly regenerates the frozen July adjacent-season n/r values and mover/stayer split; it is not claimed as independently preregistered.
